headline: 3 US Dividend Stocks Worth Watching As Treasury Yields Climb
summary: Bond yields are climbing, Washington is running a roughly $2t deficit on the way to about $40t of federal debt, and the government’s interest bill has crossed $1t a year. Income investors watching this know that higher Treasury payouts can tempt cash away from equities. This article looks at 3 large US dividend and value stocks exposed to these fiscal crosswinds and why they could still matter for your portfolio. The three stocks below are a sample.
